exercises.title: The quality report and the gate
exercises.problemHtml:
Code under test: src/ci/quality.js, .github/workflows/test.yml — mutationScore, qualityReport, .github/workflows/test.yml. It is the course's LabFlow Lite code at this point of the course; read it in the file tabs. Editing it changes nothing: the grader always uses the original.

Your task: Test the pull-request quality report of lesson 11.4: mutationScore counts killed and timed-out mutants and leaves out the ones that could not run; qualityReport turns a failed test, a missing report, coverage under a minimum (exactly at the minimum is enough), a mutation score under the break and every traceability gap into a reason not to merge. Then test the workflow file itself: ci-ok needs mutation and report, and the report step keeps its exit code through tee..

The grader runs your tests in the browser against the correct code (all must pass), then against 8 mutants — copies of the code with one planted bug each. A mutant is killed when at least one of your tests fails on it. It also applies 1 harmless change (a refactor that keeps the behaviour): your tests must stay green on it, otherwise they are testing the implementation instead of the behaviour.

The starter has a single smoke test (the code under test loads) — green, but it kills no mutant.

Requirements

  • Write your tests in src/ci/quality.test.js (Vitest syntax: describe / it / expect; more *.test.js files are fine).
  • Every test passes on the correct code and contains at least one expect (a test without an assertion fails — requireAssertions, as in the course config).
  • Kill all 8 mutants and stay green on the 1 harmless change.

Nhiệm vụ: Test báo cáo chất lượng pull request của bài 11.4: mutationScore tính đột biến bị diệt và hết giờ, bỏ ra ngoài những đột biến không chạy được; qualityReport biến một test đỏ, một báo cáo thiếu, độ phủ dưới mức tối thiểu (đúng bằng mức tối thiểu là đủ), điểm đột biến dưới ngưỡng break và mọi lỗ hổng truy vết thành lý do không được merge. Rồi test chính file workflow: ci-ok cần mutation và report, bước report giữ được mã thoát qua tee..

Code khởi đầu có đúng một test khói (code cần test nạp được) — xanh nhưng không diệt đột biến nào.

  • Diệt cả 8 đột biến và vẫn xanh với 1 thay đổi vô hại.

starterCodeJson.code:
# LabFlow Lite — tests on every pull request and on main (Chapter 9; Chapter 11 adds mutation + one quality report).
# Branch protection requires ONE status check: ci-ok (lesson 9.3). Run it on your machine with act (lesson 9.1).
name: tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:                                  # a new push to the same pull request cancels the old run (lesson 9.4)
  group: tests-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  unit:
    name: unit (Node ${{ matrix.node }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false                        # see every version's result, not only the first red one
      matrix:
        node: [22, 24]                        # package.json engines: >=22.12 (Node 20 fails 4 tests, lesson 9.4)
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
          cache: npm                          # ~/.npm, keyed by package-lock.json
      - run: npm ci
      - name: unit tests + coverage
        run: >-
          npx vitest run src/ --coverage
          --reporter=tree --reporter=github-actions
          --reporter=junit --outputFile.junit=reports/junit-unit.xml
          --reporter=json --outputFile.json=reports/unit.json
      - name: web tests
        run: npm run test:web -- --reporter=tree --reporter=github-actions --reporter=json --outputFile.json=reports/web.json
      - name: summary
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: node scripts/ci-summary.mjs "unit (Node ${{ matrix.node }})" reports/unit.json,reports/web.json coverage/coverage-summary.json | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - name: upload reports
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: unit-reports-node${{ matrix.node }}   # artifact names must be unique in a run
          path: |
            reports/
            coverage/
          retention-days: 7

  integration:
    name: integration (PostgreSQL 17)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test
          POSTGRES_DB: labflow_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres -d labflow_test"
          --health-interval 2s --health-timeout 3s --health-retries 30
    env:
      TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:test@localhost:5432/labflow_test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run test:int -- test/integration --reporter=tree --reporter=github-actions --reporter=json --outputFile.json=reports/int.json
      - name: upload report
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: int-reports
          path: reports/
          retention-days: 7

  e2e:
    name: e2e (Chromium)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - run: npm run test:e2e
      - name: upload Playwright reports
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-reports                     # playwright-report/ (HTML + traces) and reports/e2e.json (lesson 11.4)
          path: |
            playwright-report/
            reports/
          retention-days: 7

  mutation:
    name: mutation (Stryker, src/rules)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run test:mutation              # fails below thresholds.break (95) in stryker.config.mjs — lesson 11.4
      - name: upload mutation report
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: mutation-report
          path: reports/mutation/
          retention-days: 7

  quarantine:
    name: quarantine (report only)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    continue-on-error: true                   # known flaky tests: reported, never block (lesson 9.3)
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run test:quarantine -- --repeats=9

  report:
    name: quality report + traceability
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}                   # also when a test job failed: the report says what is missing
    needs: [unit, integration, e2e, mutation]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        continue-on-error: true               # a missing report is listed by the script, not a crash here
        with:
          name: unit-reports-node22
          path: .
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          name: int-reports
          path: reports/
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          name: e2e-reports
          path: .
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          name: mutation-report
          path: reports/mutation/
      - name: one page for the whole pull request
        shell: bash                           # bash -eo pipefail: "| tee" must not swallow the exit code (lesson 9.3)
        run: node scripts/ci-report.mjs | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  ci-ok:
    name: ci-ok
    if: always()                              # must run (and fail) when a job it needs failed or was skipped
    needs: [unit, integration, e2e, mutation, report]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: every required job passed?
        env:
          NEEDS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
          REQUIRED: unit,integration,e2e,mutation,report
        run: node scripts/ci-gate.mjs

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml:
The reference solution is the course’s own test file(s) for this lesson (src/ci/quality.test.js, src/ci/workflow.test.js), checked to kill every mutant and to stay green on the harmless change(s). Each mutant changes exactly one decision:

  • M1 — timed-out mutants count as survivors
  • M2 — mutants that could not compile lower the score
  • M3 — coverage exactly at the minimum blocks the merge
  • M4 — a missing report is not a problem
  • M5 — a mutation score of 94.99% passes a 95% bar
  • M6 — traceability gaps never block
  • M7 — ci-ok does not wait for mutation testing
  • M8 — tee swallows the exit code of the report

Verified in the browser grader itself. A suite kills a mutant only when some test observes that decision — which is why coverage alone does not tell you whether a suite is good.

# LabFlow Lite — tests on every pull request and on main (Chapter 9; Chapter 11 adds mutation + one quality report).
# Branch protection requires ONE status check: ci-ok (lesson 9.3). Run it on your machine with act (lesson 9.1).
name: tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:                                  # a new push to the same pull request cancels the old run (lesson 9.4)
  group: tests-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  unit:
    name: unit (Node ${{ matrix.node }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false                        # see every version's result, not only the first red one
      matrix:
        node: [22, 24]                        # package.json engines: >=22.12 (Node 20 fails 4 tests, lesson 9.4)
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
          cache: npm                          # ~/.npm, keyed by package-lock.json
      - run: npm ci
      - name: unit tests + coverage
        run: >-
          npx vitest run src/ --coverage
          --reporter=tree --reporter=github-actions
          --reporter=junit --outputFile.junit=reports/junit-unit.xml
          --reporter=json --outputFile.json=reports/unit.json
      - name: web tests
        run: npm run test:web -- --reporter=tree --reporter=github-actions --reporter=json --outputFile.json=reports/web.json
      - name: summary
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: node scripts/ci-summary.mjs "unit (Node ${{ matrix.node }})" reports/unit.json,reports/web.json coverage/coverage-summary.json | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - name: upload reports
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: unit-reports-node${{ matrix.node }}   # artifact names must be unique in a run
          path: |
            reports/
            coverage/
          retention-days: 7

  integration:
    name: integration (PostgreSQL 17)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test
          POSTGRES_DB: labflow_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres -d labflow_test"
          --health-interval 2s --health-timeout 3s --health-retries 30
    env:
      TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:test@localhost:5432/labflow_test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run test:int -- test/integration --reporter=tree --reporter=github-actions --reporter=json --outputFile.json=reports/int.json
      - name: upload report
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: int-reports
          path: reports/
          retention-days: 7

  e2e:
    name: e2e (Chromium)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - run: npm run test:e2e
      - name: upload Playwright reports
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-reports                     # playwright-report/ (HTML + traces) and reports/e2e.json (lesson 11.4)
          path: |
            playwright-report/
            reports/
          retention-days: 7

  mutation:
    name: mutation (Stryker, src/rules)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run test:mutation              # fails below thresholds.break (95) in stryker.config.mjs — lesson 11.4
      - name: upload mutation report
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: mutation-report
          path: reports/mutation/
          retention-days: 7

  quarantine:
    name: quarantine (report only)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    continue-on-error: true                   # known flaky tests: reported, never block (lesson 9.3)
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run test:quarantine -- --repeats=9

  report:
    name: quality report + traceability
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}                   # also when a test job failed: the report says what is missing
    needs: [unit, integration, e2e, mutation]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        continue-on-error: true               # a missing report is listed by the script, not a crash here
        with:
          name: unit-reports-node22
          path: .
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          name: int-reports
          path: reports/
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          name: e2e-reports
          path: .
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          name: mutation-report
          path: reports/mutation/
      - name: one page for the whole pull request
        shell: bash                           # bash -eo pipefail: "| tee" must not swallow the exit code (lesson 9.3)
        run: node scripts/ci-report.mjs | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  ci-ok:
    name: ci-ok
    if: always()                              # must run (and fail) when a job it needs failed or was skipped
    needs: [unit, integration, e2e, mutation, report]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: every required job passed?
        env:
          NEEDS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
          REQUIRED: unit,integration,e2e,mutation,report
        run: node scripts/ci-gate.mjs

# LabFlow Lite — tests on every pull request and on main (Chapter 9; Chapter 11 adds mutation + one quality report).
# Branch protection requires ONE status check: ci-ok (lesson 9.3). Run it on your machine with act (lesson 9.1).
name: tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:                                  # a new push to the same pull request cancels the old run (lesson 9.4)
  group: tests-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  unit:
    name: unit (Node ${{ matrix.node }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false                        # see every version's result, not only the first red one
      matrix:
        node: [22, 24]                        # package.json engines: >=22.12 (Node 20 fails 4 tests, lesson 9.4)
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
          cache: npm                          # ~/.npm, keyed by package-lock.json
      - run: npm ci
      - name: unit tests + coverage
        run: >-
          npx vitest run src/ --coverage
          --reporter=tree --reporter=github-actions
          --reporter=junit --outputFile.junit=reports/junit-unit.xml
          --reporter=json --outputFile.json=reports/unit.json
      - name: web tests
        run: npm run test:web -- --reporter=tree --reporter=github-actions --reporter=json --outputFile.json=reports/web.json
      - name: summary
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: node scripts/ci-summary.mjs "unit (Node ${{ matrix.node }})" reports/unit.json,reports/web.json coverage/coverage-summary.json | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - name: upload reports
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: unit-reports-node${{ matrix.node }}   # artifact names must be unique in a run
          path: |
            reports/
            coverage/
          retention-days: 7

  integration:
    name: integration (PostgreSQL 17)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test
          POSTGRES_DB: labflow_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres -d labflow_test"
          --health-interval 2s --health-timeout 3s --health-retries 30
    env:
      TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:test@localhost:5432/labflow_test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
